caption: The drawing is a monochromatic, pencil illustration of a tankard with a domed, hinged lid and a large, ornate handle. The main view, centrally positioned, displays the tankard in profile, showing its cylindrical body, prominent lid, and a curving handle with decorative scrollwork at the top and bottom. Four smaller schematic drawings are located in each corner: the top left shows a cross-section of the body, the top right displays the side profile and cross-section of the handle, the bottom left provides a circular top-down view with diameter indicated, and the bottom right presents a front view including dimensions. The entire drawing is rendered on an off-white or beige background, with fine, precise lines and shaded areas to indicate the metallic surface and curvature of the tankard. Dimensions, scales, and construction details are indicated with handwritten notations and measurement marks.
title: Pewter Tankard
